{{Short description|Football tournament group stage}}
The '''2022 Copa Sudamericana group stage''' was played from 5 April to 26 May 2022.<ref name="fixture_pdf">{{cite web|title=CONMEBOL SUDAMERICANA 2022 PROGRAMA DE PARTIDOS – FASE DE GRUPOS|url=https://www.conmebol.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/Fixture-Sudamericana_Fase-de-Grupos-2022.pdf |publisher=CONMEBOL.com|access-date=26 March 2022}}</ref> A total of 32 teams competed in the group stage to decide eight of the 16 places in the [[2022 Copa Sudamericana final stages|final stages]] of the [[2022 Copa Sudamericana]].<ref name="regulations">{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/documentos/manual-de-clubes-reglamento-conmebol-sudamericana-2022/|title=Manual de Clubes / Reglamento CONMEBOL Sudamericana 2022|publisher=CONMEBOL.com}}</ref>

==Draw==
<section begin=Draw />
The draw for the group stage was held on 25 March 2022, 12:00 [[Time in Paraguay|PYST]] ([[UTC−03:00|UTC−3]]), at the CONMEBOL Convention Centre in [[Luque]], [[Paraguay]].<ref name="Group stage draw">{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/noticias/pautas-para-el-sorteo-de-la-conmebol-sudamericana-2022/|title=Pautas para el sorteo de la CONMEBOL Sudamericana 2022|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=18 March 2022}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/noticias/los-grupos-de-la-conmebol-sudamericana-2022/|title=Los grupos de la CONMEBOL Sudamericana 2022|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=25 March 2022}}</ref><noinclude>

Teams were seeded by their ''CONMEBOL Clubs ranking'' as of 16 December 2021 (shown in parentheses),<ref name="ranking">{{cite web|url=https://conmebollibertadores.com/cards/NewsReaderWeb/ranking-de-clubes-conmebol-2022-es|title=Ranking de clubes CONMEBOL 2022|publisher=CONMEBOL Libertadores|language=es|date=17 December 2021|access-date=17 December 2021}}</ref> taking into account the following three factors:<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/sistema_de_puntaje_ranking_de_clubes_2021.pdf|title=RANKING DE CLUBES DE LA CONMEBOL 2021 SISTEMA DE PUNTAJE|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|language=es}}</ref>
#Performance in the last 10 years, taking into account Copa Libertadores and Copa Sudamericana results in the period 2012–2021.
#Historical coefficient, taking into account Copa Libertadores and Copa Sudamericana results in the period 1960–2011 and 2002–2011 respectively.
#Local tournament champion, with bonus points awarded to domestic league champions of the last 10 years.
</noinclude>
For the group stage, the 32 teams were drawn into eight groups (Groups A–H) of four containing a team from each of the four pots. Teams from the same association could not be drawn into the same group.

==Format==
<section begin=Format />
In the group stage, each group is played on a home-and-away [[round-robin tournament|round-robin]] basis. The teams are ranked according to the following criteria: 1. [[Points (association football)|Points]] (3 points for a win, 1 point for a draw, and 0 points for a loss); 2. [[Goal difference]]; 3. Goals scored; 4. Away goals scored; 5. CONMEBOL ranking (Regulations Article 2.4.2).<ref name="regulations"/>

The winners of each group advanced to the [[2022 Copa Sudamericana final stages#Round of 16|round of 16]] of the [[2022 Copa Sudamericana final stages|final stages]].<section end=Format />
